testcase.name: Scenario: Collapse and reopens the part origin branch during sketch editing: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:382:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Collapse and reopens the part origin branch during sketch editing ✔ Given a part document is open in the MCAD Software with a sketch being edited ✔ And the model browser shows an expanded Origin branch and other document entries ✔ When the user selects the expansion control beside Origin ✔ Then the Origin branch collapses and its child entries are hidden ✔ And the other document entries remain visible in the browser ✔ And the sketch remains displayed in the viewport ✔ When the user selects the expansion control beside Origin again ✔ Then the Origin branch expands and its child entries are displayed ✔ And the other document entries remain visible ✔ And the sketch remains displayed in the viewport
